tagline: Master the networks. Defend the operations.
description: A 12-week guided path into networking fundamentals and Security Operations Center work. Built for beginners who want to detect, analyze, and respond to real threats.
outcome: A detection portfolio, SIEM experience, and readiness for entry-level SOC roles.

phases.title: Phase 1 — Networking Foundations
phases.subtitle: Weeks 1–4 · Understand how networks actually work

items.title: OSI Model & TCP/IP
items.detail: The 7 layers explained clearly — the backbone of all networking.

items.title: IP Addressing & Subnetting
items.detail: Learn how devices find each other — including CIDR and subnet masks.

items.title: DNS, DHCP, HTTP, HTTPS
items.detail: How names resolve, addresses assign, and data moves securely.

items.title: Mini Project: Home Lab
items.detail: Set up two VMs that can ping and talk to each other on a private network.

phases.title: Phase 2 — Security Fundamentals
phases.subtitle: Weeks 5–8 · Learn how attacks happen and how to spot them

items.title: Firewalls, IDS & IPS
items.detail: How traffic is filtered and how intrusions are detected in real time.

items.title: Wireshark Packet Analysis
items.detail: Capture and inspect your own traffic to understand what normal looks like.

items.title: SIEM Basics
items.detail: Pick Splunk Free or ELK Stack — learn to search and correlate logs.

items.title: Mini Project: Attack & Detect
items.detail: Simulate a small network attack in your lab, then detect it using logs.

items.title: Log Analysis
items.detail: Understand Windows Event Logs and Syslog — the language of SOC work.

items.title: MITRE ATT&CK Framework
items.detail: Learn the top 10 techniques attackers use — and how to detect each.

items.title: Incident Response Basics
items.detail: Follow a real SOC workflow: detect → triage → respond → report.

items.title: Apply for Entry-Level Roles
items.detail: Build a detection portfolio — screenshots, writeups, and dashboards.
